summary: Regression pass after ADDITIVE Vercel-compat changes (api/index.py entry, root requirements.txt, vercel.json, SMTP branch guarded by SMTP_HOST env, ensure_startup idempotency called from startup + login, REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL fallback to '' in Contact/Growth/ServicePage/Admin). Verified on preview URL https://clean-tech-hero.preview.emergentagent.com. Vercel ASGI import works: `python -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'api'); import index; print(index.app.title)"` prints 'Vertical Infinity API'. Full pytest suite (3 files, 50 tests): 49 passed, 1 pre-existing wildcard-CORS failure (already documented in iterations 4 & 5, explicitly excluded per request). GET /api/ returns {message:'Vertical Infinity API is live'}. Repeated POST /api/auth/login (3x) all return 200 -> ensure_startup idempotency holds (module-level flag prevents rehashing/reseed on every call). Admin session works: /auth/me, GET /api/contact lists 3 leads, PATCH /api/contact/{id}/status new<->contacted, unauth 401, PATCH invalid status 422, 404 on unknown id. GET /api/reviews 200 with aggregate rating=4.9, review_count=21. FRONTEND: homepage loads and Contact form submits successfully (button transitions to 'Sent!'). /product-development service page loads, embedded Contact submits successfully. /admin login with admin creds -> lead inbox with 3 leads rendered; clicking status pill updates badge (NEW -> CONTACTED) and PATCH call succeeds. Contact form uses data-testid attrs as expected.

minor.issue: PRE-EXISTING (iterations 4 & 5, explicitly excluded from this run's scope): CORS_ORIGINS='*' forces allow_credentials=False. Not a regression from Vercel-compat changes.
Still uses deprecated @app.on_event; DeprecationWarning at boot. Not a regression; migrate to lifespan when convenient.

action_items: None required — Vercel-compat additive changes verified with zero regressions on Emergent preview.
Optional (carried over): replace CORS_ORIGINS='*' with explicit allowlist if cookie auth is ever consumed cross-origin.
critical_code_review_comments: api/index.py cleanly re-exports backend.server:app via sys.path insertion — import succeeds and app.title matches.
vercel.json rewrites correctly route /api/* to the ASGI function and everything else to index.html (SPA fallback); no static asset regex conflict observed.

server.py send_lead_alert SMTP branch is env-gated (SMTP_HOST); on preview neither SMTP_HOST nor VERCEL env is set, so behaviour reduces to the existing Emergent Resend background-task path — POST /api/contact stays fast (200 in <500ms observed in logs).
ensure_startup() has a module-level flag; login handler calls it at request-start with negligible overhead once initialised. Verified via 3 back-to-back logins all returning 200.

Frontend fallback `${process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL || ''}` is correct: on Vercel deploy where env is empty, it produces a same-origin relative URL that matches the /api rewrite; on preview it correctly hits the configured absolute backend URL.
server.py still 445+ lines — auth/contact/reviews would benefit from being split into routers, but not urgent.
